info.ap:
You gain 1 AP at the start of each cycle, up to {{maxAp}}. Unspent AP carries over.
Lying down in a bed or on a sofa gives 1 more AP each cycle (2 in all). Any other action gets you up.
Food and drink restore AP.
Most actions cost AP. With no MP left, a move converts {{apPerConversion}} AP into {{mpPerConversion}} MP.
info.mp:
Each move to another room costs {{mpPerMove}} MP. Walking about the room is free.
MP is kept from cycle to cycle, up to {{mpCap}}.
With no MP left, a move converts {{apPerConversion}} AP into {{mpPerConversion}} MP.
info.hp:
Everyone heals 1 HP at the start of each day. At 0 HP you die.
Heal restores 3 HP: carry a Medikit, or use the Medlab without one (2 AP on someone else, 3 AP on yourself).
Combat actions deplete the target's HP.
Injuries while building, dismantling or repairing cost HP.
A hungry human (24 cycles after their last meal wears off) loses 1 HP each cycle until they eat.
A Mush loses 4 HP each time they shower.
info.morale:
Everyone loses 2 morale at the start of each day (1 while Chun is alive).
A Shrink's Comfort gives 2 morale. Lying down in a room with a Shrink gives 1 morale each cycle.
A Leader's Fiery speech gives everyone else in the room 2 morale.
Eating an Uncooked ration costs 1 morale.

desc.dirty: Can't research. Taking a shower removes it.
desc.full_belly: You can't eat more until you are hungrier.
desc.hungry: You lose health every cycle until you eat something.
desc.immune: Attempts to infect you do nothing for now.
desc.immunity: A trait: attempts to infect you never do anything. It can't be removed.
desc.pacifist: Every aggressive action in this person's room costs 2 more AP, theirs included. Stacks with other pacifists. It can't be removed.
desc.hyperactive: A trait: this person gains 1 more MP at each cycle change, and gets no extra AP from lying down. It can't be removed.
desc.guardian: While this person guards the room, everyone else can only leave by the door they came in through, or not at all if they arrived another way. It ends when the guardian leaves, is moved or dies.
desc.mankind_only_hope: A trait: while this person is alive, the whole crew loses 1 less morale each day. It can't be removed.
desc.wheelchair: A trait: anyone in this person's room can offer to push their wheelchair. While pushed, they move with the pusher at no MP cost. It can't be removed.
desc.accommodated: Someone is pushing this person's wheelchair: they go wherever their pusher goes, at no MP cost, and can't move alone. Either of them can end it.
desc.genius: Your next Research, Project, or Repair is completed instantly.
desc.outcast: Cursed by a Persecutor: every action of theirs that rolls succeeds 20% less, and nothing they do is secret. It ends when the Persecutor or they die, or when they go inactive.
desc.cold_disease:
-3 Max Morale.
Your punches deal 1 less damage.
On cycle change, you have a 33% chance to lose 1 MP.
desc.extreme_tinnitus_disease:
-3 Max Morale.
You lose 2 morale when the ship moves.
You lose 2 health when the ship moves.
desc.fungal_infection_disease:
-2 Max HP.
-2 Max Morale.
You need 1 less spore to be converted.
On cycle change, you become dirty.
desc.inactive: Hasn't connected for 24 hours. Holds no title, can't be taken over by a Transfer, and a punch lands on them 90% of the time. Ends as soon as they connect.
desc.super_inactive: Hasn't connected for 48 hours. Also skipped by the Logistics Expert. Ends as soon as they connect.
desc.focused: At a terminal, looking at its screen. Ends when they close it, walk off or leave the room.
desc.contaminated: A human you have contaminated. At their capacity they turn Mush.
desc.hopeless: At 0 morale. Any morale gain ends it. A human still Hopeless when the cycle ends dies.

desc.engineer: The Engineer is qualified to repair the Daedalus's equipment, fittings and hull.
desc.astrophysician: The Astrophysicist is authorized to run scans to find planets in range or determine their composition.
desc.pilot: The pilot is an expert at maneuvering the Icarus, Pasiphae and Patrol Ship. Their mastery of flight is impressive.
desc.gunman: The gunman handles weapons of every kind with great ease.
desc.cook: The cook is a formidable expert at preparing good meals. They also have an informed opinion on nearly everything edible.
desc.botanic: The botanist can tell the characteristics of vegetables and plants apart. They are also remarkably efficient at maintaining the Garden.
desc.biologist: The biologist is more efficient at laboratory research.
desc.designer: The designer has two free actions each day to use NERON's Core.
desc.medic: The doctor has medical training, which allows quick and precise treatment. They are also qualified to perform surgery.
desc.first_aid: The nurse is always ready to help.
desc.leadership: A charismatic leader knows how to run the crew effectively and raise morale with fiery speeches.
desc.sturdy: You suffer no penalty when carrying a heavy object. Handy for hand-to-hand combat too.
desc.sprint: The Sprinter always starts the day on the right foot! They enjoy extra Movement Points.
desc.fireman: The Firefighter has a long career behind them, so they always succeed with the extinguisher... and can even manage without one!
desc.hunt: The Tracker sees where each crew movement comes from and where it goes. They can also print an investigation result on the tabulator during the game: a list of people containing at least one Mush-infected.
desc.survival: The survival expert is a great asset on exploration missions. They defend better against alien life forms and get through things better than others.
desc.unconcerned: The detached are cold, hard, impermeable. They are not affected by the death of their comrades.
desc.computer: The computer scientist is at ease behind a screen. They master the interfaces of the nexus, navigation and communication terminals to perfection.
desc.radio_expert: The radio expert can decode the most tangled space waves to reconstruct or send messages to the other end of the Universe.
desc.diplomacy: A good diplomat knows how to make contact with extraterrestrial races.
desc.mankind_only_hope: Their extraordinary immune system makes them humanity's only hope. As long as they stay alive, we have a small chance of fighting off the Mush invasion.
desc.shrink: The shrink holds a psychological support position. They help keep morale up and cure psychological illnesses.
desc.persistent: Once they have started a task, nothing can disturb the persevering player.
desc.robotics: The robotics expert can build and handle drones as they see fit.
desc.paranoid: The paranoid believe all their colleagues are potentially dangerous, and always watch their back with extra cameras.
desc.caffeinomaniac: The caffeine addict works twice as well as their colleagues as long as they have access to the coffee machine.
desc.physicist: The physicist is a top-flight physics researcher; their grasp of quantum mechanics and of the very strings that make up our Universe is their strength. They have advantages when repairing PILGRED.
desc.apprentice: By closely watching their teachers' activities, the apprentice can eventually reproduce their every move.
desc.premonition: Your intuition never fails you; you can replay a crewmate's latest activity as a bright flashback. It's handy, but it hurts your head.
desc.wrestler: The wrestler's German suplexes make every opponent's vertebrae tremble.
desc.green_thumb: Plants grow naturally in your presence; you only need to give them a languorous look for them to produce their finest fruit.
desc.genius: When divinely lit by the flame of knowledge, the genius can find the solution to any problem on the Daedalus.
desc.observant: You spend 1 less AP to find hidden objects, and you have a 25% chance to detect a discreet action in your room.
desc.torturer: The torturer knows every most sensitive nerve circuit, to get their most important message across... You WILL talk.
desc.crazy_eye: You cannot be surprised; you anticipate every move of your enemies, and of your supposed allies too.
desc.logistics: You personally see to the proper organization of the Daedalus, to maximize each crewmate's possibilities.
desc.rebel: Your ties to the anti-Mush resistance let you understand and decode rebel signals much faster than any other radio expert.
desc.escape: You are fearful by nature and know how to slip away from any attempt at physical contact.
desc.neron_only_friend: When you are aboard the ship, NERON is soothed, its routines run without errors, and its performance improves greatly.
desc.stickler: You work clean, very clean, ever cleaner, cleaner still. You are properly neurotic about cleanliness, but it has its upsides.
desc.daunting: Sometimes the prey escapes only because it has the chance.
desc.juge: Some well-aimed remarks can have unexpected repercussions.
desc.creative: Sometimes you have to turn the problem around.
desc.fast_backward: You have to know when to change your certainties.
desc.abnegation: Some particularly resilient people can endure the unbearable. But the price is high.
desc.antic_perfume: Ah, they knew how to make fresh perfumes at Fragonard in nineteen eighty-four showers...
desc.metaliciste: You can truly say you are someone productive!
desc.space_tactics: At a certain degree of megalomania, you can call it talent. You are an expert in space battle, but everyone thinks you are mad.
desc.devoted: In the heat of the action, you can be counted on.
desc.skilful: You have some knowledge... it can always come in handy.
desc.expert: Your skills are incredible, but you work without really worrying about certain consequences...
desc.confident: Discreet and faithful, you attract sympathy, and you carry a bit of the world's misery too...
desc.strong_skin: Sure, a brute, but a stickler for cleanliness all the same. Don't touch me, you'll get me dirty!
desc.gunner: Someone will finally show them what it's for.
desc.polymath: Knowledge is in motion; the state is already gone.
desc.politician: They are with you or against you!
desc.cold_blood: In space, anything can happen. Knowing how to keep calm is an asset.
desc.optimistic: The end of humanity... Could be worse, right?
desc.lethargy: You are only awake 4 hours a day, but in so little time you work miracles!
desc.panic: It's when everything goes wrong that you reveal your full potential: screaming very loudly and running in every direction.
desc.mycologist: The mycologist can treat fungal infections in the Sick Bay or with a Medikit.
desc.frugivore: You terrorize fruit, you adore it, it's your drug. When a fruit meets your gaze, it goes overripe at once.
desc.opportunist: The opportunist waits for the first chance to climb the ship's hierarchy; no opportunity escapes them.
desc.bodyguard: You don't know of a single escort mission you didn't see through. That must be what having a crazy eye means...
desc.infantryman: A service weapon and standard training so you stop shooting yourself in the foot: you are a worthy example of what high society calls cannon fodder.
desc.maintenance_agent: In a world of specialists, the maintenance agent shines by following their own path. And if that path ends up shining too, you can thank them.
desc.pyromane: The pyromaniac can inject explosive microspores into a flammable surface to start a violent fire that may eventually damage the ship.
desc.tough: Your skin is particularly tough. Plastenite without the sweat.
desc.fertile: Your spore production is remarkable for your kind. Once a spore, always a spore.
desc.ninja: Thanks to your supercharged myelin, you move incredibly fast.
desc.sapper: Your saliva produces a light acid, enough to short-circuit just about anything...
desc.nimble_fingers: With a little help from your rhizomes you can do wonderful things. Like handling Cameras, for example...
desc.water_resistant: Fungal research has come up with a new mucus, perfect for keeping up appearances.
desc.traitor: You have a knack for attracting trouble. Look, a mankarog... What if we tickled it to see what happens...
desc.doorman: Some creeping parasols can mimic this nasty effect of proactive puffed rice. And as luck would have it, the Mush sent you their genotype.
desc.neron_access: The ambiguities in NERON's code towards the Mush are so delicious sometimes...
desc.fungus_cook: A great classic of modern gastronomy on Sol.
desc.radio_piracy: This prehistoric means of communication is overrated. So be it.
desc.nightmare: The Mush's lepiota can reshape the brainwaves of these poor humans. With a few tweaks, they can stop a human from resting.
desc.disheartening_contact: Mush pheromones don't allow direct communication, but saturating them can unsettle humans. And you know how to use them.
desc.transfert: The Mush has passed you the genotype of one of our weapons of mass transmission. Use it without restraint.
desc.bacterial_contact: The bacteria on your feet can have particularly virulent uses.
desc.infectious_agent: You make holes. Little holes. Lots of little holes.
desc.phagocytosis: When things get tough, you have THE solution.
desc.mycellium_spirit: Your mission is sacred. The Mush has chosen you as its major trans-dimensional fungal relay.
desc.anonymous: Your mycotoxins are undetectable in the air. You are the predator, after all!
desc.massggedon: Some penicillia are extremely virulent. The effect is short-lived but very effective.
desc.nerondepress: When NERON feels bad, the whole Daedalus throws up.
desc.slimetrap: These darn mushrooms breed fast, too fast, way too fast... They're everywhere!!!
desc.electro_slime: You produce a strange green acid jelly from your armpits...
desc.defacer: Your DNA lets you change some peripheral data sequences. Lots of potential!

You have double the odds of success for Renovations.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.

The Scan a Planet action costs 1 AP less for you.

effects.pilot:

You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.

You have half the odds of critical failure when using a firearm.
You have double double the odds of critical hits when shooting.

effects.cook:
You get +4 Cook action points per day.
You can read the properties of foods.

You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.

You get +2 Gardening action points per day.

You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.designer:
You get +2 NERON Projects action points per day.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.medic:
You can read the properties of medicines.
You have a +4% bonus on each Laboratory Research.
Your Heal actions restore 2 more HP.
You can perform Operations.
effects.first_aid:
You get +2 free Heal action points each day.

You get 1 extra option when dispensing drugs.
effects.leadership: Action: Fiery Speech- For 2 AP, give all crewmembers in the room 2 morale.
effects.sturdy:
Your melee attacks deal 1 extra point of damage (Does not stack with Wrestler or Mutation).
You have no penalties for heavy objects.

effects.sprint:
You gain 2 more MP on each AP-to-MP conversion (does not stack with the Scooter).
Expedition: Your team will visit 1 additional sector.
effects.fireman:
You will always succeed at Extinguishing fires when using an Extinguisher.
Action: Extinguish Manually- For 1 AP, Attempt to extinguish a fire without an Extinguisher.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.hunt:
You can see logs from up to 16 cycles ago.
You can see where crewmembers move to and from.
You can see what ships crewmembers use to takeoff and land.
You can print the List on the Tabulator.
Expedition: You will always find crewmembers alive in MIA sectors.
effects.survival:
Expedition: All damage you take is reduced by one.
Expedition: Your team will gain 1 additional Alien Steak during Provision events.
Expedition: You will always be chosen last to die during Fatal Accident events.
effects.unconcerned:
You get +25% success rate to your next action for every cycle you spend alone.
The bonus is lost if you are ever in the same room as another crewmember.
effects.computer:
You get +2 Computing action points per day.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.radio_expert:
You are twice as effective when establishing contact with Sol.
You improve the Sol contact attempts of crewmates in the same room as you by 50%.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.diplomacy:
Traders will offer additional trades when you are on the Bridge.
Action: Ceasefire- Once per game, For 1 AP, Prevent all aggressive actions in the room you are in for 3 cycles.
Expedition: Replaces Combat events with Nothing to report.
Expedition: Replaces the Combat events in the Intelligant Life sector with the New Sector event.
effects.mankind_only_hope: The daily morale loss is reduced by 1 point.
effects.shrink:
Each cycle, 1 Morale Point is regenerated for each character lying down in the same room as you.
Cures psychological illnesses.
Action: Comfort- For 1 AP, give a crewmember 2 morale.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.persistent: After a failed action, the your chances of success increases faster.
effects.robotics:
You start with a drone blueprint.
You can upgrade drones using metal scraps.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.paranoid:
You start with a Camera.
You can install and uninstall cameras for free.
effects.caffeinomaniac:
You get +2 AP when you drink a Coffee.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.physicist:
You get 1 PILGRED repair action point per day.
You get a bonus for developing certain NERON Projects.
effects.apprentice: Action: Apprenticeship- Once per game, for 1 AP, copy a skill from a crewmember in the room.
effects.premonition: Action: Premonition- For 1 Morale, you can see another crewmate's last action.
effects.wrestler:
Your melee attacks deal 2 extra damage (Does not stack with Solid or Mutation).
Action: Throw Out- For 2 AP, move crewmember to a random adjacent room (Costs 1 less on inactive crewmembers).
effects.green_thumb:
Gives you two extra hydropots when picked.
Plants you graft will start at 25% of their total growth time.
effects.genius: Action: Eureka moment- Once per game, for free, make the next Research, Project, or Repair you work on finish instantly.
effects.observant:
The Search action costs you 1 AP less.
You have a 25% chance to detect discreet actions in your room.
effects.torturer: Action: Torture- Once per day, For 1 AP, you can deal 1 damage to a crewmember and reveal their last X actions, where X is the amount of Hp.
effects.crazy_eye: All aggressive actions targeting you cost 2 extra AP.
effects.logistics: Each cycle, 1 AP is given to a random crewmate in your room.
effects.rebel: Doubles your progress when contacting the rebel bases.
effects.escape:
Melee attacks against you have a 25% penalty.
You can move regardless of any Guards in the room.
effects.neron_only_friend:
All crewmembers will always achieve the maximum amount of progress when working on Neron projects.
CPU priorities are boosted.
Project and Research priorities grant an additional +1% bonus.
Astronavigation priority has a 33% chance to reveal an additional sector.
You can change the CPU priority an unlimited number of times per day.
effects.stickler: You never get accidentally dirty when performing actions on the ship.
effects.daunting: Daily. For 1 AP, intimidate a player. They lose 2 AP and 4 MP.
effects.juge:
For 1 AP, cast an anathema on a crewmate.
That crewmate gains the Pariah status. A Pariah loses 20% success on their actions.
Their covert actions become secret.
The Pariah status lasts as long as the persecutor is alive.
If the Pariah dies and is Mush, the persecutor gains 8 triumph points; otherwise they lose 8.
effects.creative: Each of your failures on an action that costs AP has a 50% chance to give you back 1 AP.
effects.fast_backward:
Expedition: You can see what the next sector will be.
Expedition: For 2 AP, end the expedition and return to the ship.
effects.abnegation: If your morale drops to 0, you do not die, but you lose 1 HP per cycle.
effects.antic_perfume: After each shower, you gain 2 cycles of immunity to Mush infection.
effects.metaliciste: Action: Snoop- In each storage room, once per day, for free, find scrap, fuel, oxygen, or rations.
effects.space_tactics: 50% chance to reduce each hunter wave by 33%.
effects.devoted: You gain 3 more AP when you accept a mission.
effects.skilful: You count as a Botanist, Diplomat and Biologist, but do not get their actions and resources.
effects.expert: Your action successes are improved by 20%, but so are injuries and dirt.
effects.confident: Once a day, other players can confide in a confident. Doing so reveals to you their last X actions, where X is your amount of morale, and gains them 2 morale.
effects.strong_skin:
You have a 50% chance to be immune to Mush contamination.
You have 50% resistance to physical illnesses.
effects.motivator: Action: Boring Speech- For 2 AP, give 3 MP to everyone in the room.
effects.gunner:
Doubles the damage of your turret shots.
Raises your chance to hit with turrets by 50%.
effects.polymath:
+2 accessible private channels.
+1 Computing action point per day.
effects.politician: Action: Coup. For 3 AP at a NERON core, stage a coup. At the next cycle change, you become the Commander.
effects.cold_blood: Youu gain 3 AP each time a crewmate dies.
effects.optimistic: You lose 1 less Morale point per day.
effects.lethargy:
If you stay lying down for at least 4 cycles, you gain 1 extra AP per cycle. The bonus is lost if you get up.
The maximum capacity of your AP gauge is doubled.
effects.panic: You gain 1 extra AP and 1 extra MP each cycle while 8 or fewer humans.
effects.frugivore:
You gain 2 extra AP when you eat alien fruit
You gain 1 extra AP when eat a banana.
effects.opportunist: +5 AP the first time you gain each title.
effects.bodyguard:
For 1 AP, you can Protect another crew member.
While you are in the same room, every aggressive action targeting them costs 2 extra AP.
effects.infantryman:
Doubles your chance to hit with turrets.
+1 Shoot point per day.
Starts the game with a customized Blaster.
effects.maintenance_agent: You gain +1 Repair action point, +1 Gardening action point and +1 Cook action point per day.
effects.pyromane: For 4 AP you can start a Fire in a room.
effects.tough: Each point of combat damage dealt to you is reduced by one.
effects.fertile: Each day, you can create a spore for free.
effects.ninja: Your melee attacks become anonymous actions.
effects.sapper: Your chances of success when Sabotaging equipment or items are tripled.
effects.nimble_fingers: Your assemble and dismantle actions are discreet on Cameras.
effects.water_resistant: Taking a shower doesn't cost you any HP, and costs 1 AP at most, soap or not.
effects.traitor:
Expedition: You can see what the next sector will be.
Expedition: Once per expedition, for free, force a bad event to occur in the next cycle.
effects.doorman: Each day, you can Sabotage a Door for free.
effects.neron_access: You can access NERON's BIOS even if you are not the Administrator.
effects.fungus_cook: You can make a Trapped Ration by mixing a Spore and a Ration, for 1 AP.
effects.radio_piracy: For 3 AP you can jam the communications of a player who has a Walkie-Talkie. This breaks their Walkie-Talkie and lets you write in their place until they speak again.
effects.nightmare: For 0 AP, you can give nightmares to a player who is lying down. They no longer get the sleep bonuses.
effects.disheartening_contact: For 2 AP you can make a crewmate lose 2 Morale Points.
effects.transfert:
Unique: you can slip into the skin of another human player. They must have been infected at least once. They will end up in your body... and may alert their fellows.
Triumph scores will be swapped.
effects.bacterial_contact: For 1 AP you can give a crewmate a disease. This is a stealthy action.
effects.infectious_agent: Lets you Spike one more time each day.
effects.phagocytosis: For 0 AP, you can devour a Spore, which gives you 4 AP and 4 HP.
effects.trapper: For 1 AP, you can trap a Room with a Spore. If anyone handles an item or equipment in the room, they become Infected. If it is a Mush (or you), the spore is lost.
effects.mycellium_spirit: While you are alive, the Mush can make 1 more Spore per day.
effects.anonymous: You appear as a Human in the crew bar, except when you die.
effects.massggedon: Unique: for 2 AP and 2 spores, you can take 2 AP from every crew member and make them dirty.
effects.nerondepress:
For 3 AP, you can confuse NERON next cycle, which changes its settings at random.
Doesn't work on the DMZ restriction if it is locked.
effects.slimetrap: For 1 AP, the targeted player will become dirty in 1 to 4 cycles.
effects.electro_slime: For 1 AP, you can make an electronic item break. It takes several cycles to break down.
effects.defacer: Once a day. For 2 AP, you can erase all of a room's logs. Logs are recorded again from the next cycle.

drugDispenser.label: Drug Dispenser
drugDispenser.none: Nothing to take right now: the dispenser has been used, and resets on cycles 1 and 4.

desc.DRUG_DISPENSER: The distiller can be used once a day to make a drug.
desc.MYCOSCAN: Detects spores on a healthy crew member.
desc.PATULINE_SCRAMBLER: The infected can no longer communicate on the Mush channel.
desc.FUNGUS_SCRAMBLER: Hunters have a 20% chance on each shot of targeting one of their own.
desc.PHEROMODEM: The tracker can now be used to communicate on the Mush channel.
desc.CONSTIPASPORE_SERUM: Raises the cost of creating spores by 2.
desc.HEALING_OINTMANT: Healing actions restore 1 extra health point.
desc.NATAMY_GUN: Turns the sample blaster into a Natamy rifle.
desc.TESLA_SUP2X: Doubles the maximum charges of the Daedalus turrets.
desc.INFINITE_WATER: The whole crew gains 3 triumph points.
desc.GUARANA_CAPUCCINO: Coffees give their drinker 1 extra action point.
desc.MUSHICIDE_SOAP: Each shower destroys one spore on you.
desc.MUSHOPHAGE_BACTERIA: Humans can withstand up to 3 spores before turning Mush.
desc.ANTISPORE_GAZ: The Mush's daily spore maximum is reduced by two.
desc.SUPER_CALC: Produces a piece of equipment in the Nexus that extracts data from crystallites.

relay.help: Your contributions only lose value when you've made more than everyone else combined, plus one.
relay.waiting: Up to {{percent}}% more once others contribute.

astro.title: Your planets

desc.PATROL_SHIP_LAUNCHER: Takeoff maneuvers cost less action points.
desc.PATROLSHIP_BLASTER_GUN: Raises the firepower of patrol ships by one point.
desc.BAY_DOOR_XXL: Takeoff and landing maneuvers are much easier.
desc.FIRE_SENSOR: Fires are reported on your personal modules.
desc.DOOR_SENSOR: Jammed doors are reported on your personal modules.
desc.EQUIPMENT_SENSOR: Damaged equipment is reported on your personal modules.
desc.QUANTUM_SENSORS: The planet scanner reveals one more sector per attempt.
desc.CHIPSET_ACCELERATION: Searching for a planet costs 1 action point less.
desc.ICARUS_ANTIGRAV_PROPELLER: Improves your chances of landing on planets.
desc.ICARUS_LARGER_BAY: The Icarus can carry 2 more people.
desc.ICARUS_LAVATORY: You don't get dirty returning from an expedition.
desc.NERON_PROJECT_THREAD: Any project above 0% is improved by 5% automatically each cycle.
desc.ARMOUR_CORRIDOR: Every attack the Daedalus takes is reduced by one point.
desc.PLASMA_SHIELD: The Daedalus hull is protected by a self-regenerating shield.
desc.EXTRA_HYDROPONPOTS: Adds 3 pots to grow new plants.
desc.HYDROPONIC_INCUBATOR: In the garden, young plants grow twice as fast.
desc.HEAT_LAMP: In the garden, a 50% chance of producing an extra fruit.
desc.AUXILIARY_TERMINAL: NERON's core can also be reached from the sick bay and the engine room.
desc.AUTO_WATERING: Each fire has a 25% chance of going out by itself every cycle.
desc.RADAR_TRANS_VOID: The star antenna doubles the progress of attempts to connect with Sol.
desc.MAGNETIC_NET: When the Daedalus moves, patrol ships are brought back on board automatically.
desc.FOOD_RETAILER: Creates 2 pneumatic input tubes and 1 pneumatic output tube. Items can be sent through the input tubes to the output tube.
desc.DISMANTLING: Produces 5 metal scraps in the engine room.
desc.AUTO_RETURN_ICARUS: The Icarus returns to the Daedalus by itself if the mission fails.
desc.EXTRA_DRONE: Adds a drone in the Nexus to look after the Daedalus.
desc.FISSION_COFFEE_ROASTER: The coffee machine also recharges at cycle 5.
desc.TRAIL_REDUCER: Cuts the number of attackers that follow you after a trip by 50%.
desc.TRASH_LOAD: Produces 4 metal scraps and 4 plastic scraps.
desc.WHOS_WHO: Shows your crewmates' identities on the tracker.
desc.CALL_OF_DIRTY: Makes the Dynarcade available in Alpha Bay 2. Blow off steam at the cost of a few bruises; it restores morale.
desc.BEAT_BOX: Makes the jukebox available in Alpha Bay 2. Relax by listening to music.
desc.THALASSO: If you aren't Mush, each shower has a 25% chance of giving you +1 health, or +1 morale, or +2 movement points.
desc.FLOOR_HEATING: Reduces injuries caused by actions by 25%.
desc.NOISE_REDUCER: Raises every crewmate's maximum action points by 2.
desc.NERON_TARGETING_ASSIST: Raises aim in flight and on turrets by 25%.
desc.PARASITE_ELIM: Young plants in the garden need 4 fewer cycles to grow.
desc.OXY_MORE: Each cycle the Daedalus has a 20% chance of saving the crew's oxygen.
desc.BRIC_BROC: Each cycle the Daedalus has a 15% chance of not falling apart.
desc.APERO_KITCHEN: Improves the refectory kitchen. From cycle 6, the kitchen gives each player present a 6% chance of +1 XP. Happy hour at cycle 7 gives 2 XP. A successful aperitif needs at least 2 people.

plasma_shield.name: Plasma shield
plasma_shield.desc: While on, the shield takes part of each hit and regenerates every cycle. While off, it takes nothing; switched back on, it has the points it had.

comms.rebelOpen_other: {{percent}}% decoded. The signal is lost in {{count}} cycles.

LUYTEN_CETI.effect: Nobody needs an iTrackie to talk at a distance.

CYGNI.name: Auroras of Cygni
CYGNI.effect: +3 morale for the whole crew. Patrol ship shots do 1 extra damage.

xyloph.NOTHING: Corrupted data. Nothing to get out of it.
xyloph.SNOW_CRASH: Snow… Your screen fills with crackling static. The link is lost.
xyloph.WIREFLESS_INFIDELITY: Wireless infidelity… The link is lost and the signal is much weaker.
xyloph.MUSH_GENOME_DATA: Genome. A disk of Mush genome data was printed on the bridge.
xyloph.LOST_ANALYSIS: Finola's lost analysis. The crew's infection levels at departure.
xyloph.NILS_CARLSSON_CONTACT: Contact with Nils Carlsson! A Mush test strain was printed on the bridge.
xyloph.NERON_BOOST: Access to NERON's lost database. NERON's update moves forward.
xyloph.KIVANC_TERZI_CONTACT: Contact with Kivanç Terzi restored! Decoding rebel signals goes faster.
xyloph.COOK_BIBLE: The 2830 Labrousse cookbook. A cooking skill book was printed on the bridge.
xyloph.ZONG_CHUN_SAMPLE: Zong Chun's genome codex. The laboratory now has her genome.
xyloph.SCHOOL_MANUALS: School manuals. Two skill books were printed on the bridge.
xyloph.WORKSHOP_MANUALS: Workshop manuals. Three blueprints were printed on the bridge.

command.solCommanderOnly: Only the Commander can take the ship to Sol.

navigation.heading: Facing {{direction}}
navigation.traveling: The ship is traveling. It arrives at the next cycle change.
navigation.jumpConfirm: Warning: moving the ship can have major consequences. Patrol ships in flight are lost with their pilots, an expedition still out is stranded, and a rebel signal being decoded is lost. Consult your crewmates before going ahead.
navigation.warning: Travel burns all the fuel in the combustion chamber, and the ship goes that far. With none loaded the AP is wasted. Every planet not lying exactly ahead at that distance is lost.

bodyTaken.title: Your body has been taken!
bodyTaken.text: A Mush has slipped into your body. You wake up in theirs: you are now {{name}}, and still human.

expedition.lootOnFloorShip: Everything you found is on the floor of {{bay}}.

noMp.title: Out of MP

welcome.title: Welcome aboard
welcome.bodyEndCycle: You gain AP every cycle, and unspent AP is kept. Spend it on actions, then press End cycle when you're done.
welcome.bodyClock: You gain AP every cycle, and unspent AP is kept. A new cycle starts when the countdown to the next cycle runs out.
